dossier.headline: Iran's tanker mine claims in Hormuz return, and are disputed
dossier.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards have repeatedly claimed tanker mine strikes in Hormuz since early November; one live tally put Saturday's incidents at five in 24 hours. On Monday they said two more tankers hit mines, after six caught fire over two days. Iran says the ships used unauthorised routes, while the US military says it has cleared the main routes; none of the claims has been independently verified.
why_it_matters: Hormuz is a key route for crude, and the notes tie oil moves directly to Indian inflation, the rupee and equities
Oil rose in early Asian trade on earlier reports of strikes in the region
Brent last settled on Friday, before the weekend's reports
watch: Further mine claims and any independent confirmation
